description: Town NPC dialogue lines per iteration. Each NPC has 200+ lines distributed across 9 iterations + neutral fallback. Loaded by DialogueManager keyed on npc_id + iteration_number.

neutral: fallback lines available across all iterations

schema.first_meet: the first time the player ever interacts with this NPC
schema.quest_active: lines while a quest is active

first_meet: Oh! A new face! Welcome to my shop, friend.
Pixel's the name. I sell what you need to survive out there.
neutral: Good to see you again!
Anything you need today?
I just got a fresh batch of healing potions in.
The dungeon's been rough on adventurers lately.
Watch the prices, they fluctuate based on what's coming up from below.
I've got a special on data shards if you're interested.
Don't forget to upgrade your gear before going back down.
iter_1: The simulation feels new today, doesn't it?
iter_5: You've been at this a while now. I respect that.
iter_9: Final iteration. I... I hope I see you again, friend.

first_meet: Hmm. New customer. Show me what you've got... mhm.
I can work with this. Bring me materials and I'll make you something dangerous... mhm.
neutral: Bring me ore, I make weapons... mhm.
Soot in my eye again... mhm.
You'll need better armor for the deeper floors... mhm.
My grandfather forged blades for the founders... mhm.
Hammer never lies... mhm.
Hot enough today... mhm.
iter_3: The fire burns differently this iteration. Hmm.
iter_9: I've made you a thousand swords by now... mhm. They all break eventually.

first_meet: Welcome to the Tavern. The regulars say... well, they say a lot of things.
Sit. Drink. Tell me what brings you to our corner.
neutral: The regulars say the lower floors are stirring.
Care for a drink? On the house, this round.
I hear everything in this place. Most of it is gossip. Some of it isn't.
Forge was in here last night, complaining about the soot.
The Sage came in once. Drank water. Left a tip.
Bit's parents asked if I've seen them. I haven't.
iter_2: The regulars say the second iteration always feels like deja vu.
iter_9: Drinks are on the house. Today only. Don't ask why.

first_meet: Welcome to the library. Speak softly, the books are old.
I am Index. I keep what is worth keeping.
neutral: Page 147 of the third volume mentions an iteration cycle...
The old records speak of one like you.
Each iteration adds another page. Most are blank.
If you find any data shards, bring them to me.
Knowledge is the only thing that survives the reset.
I've cataloged 8,432 entries about the Compiler. None are conclusive.
iter_4: This iteration's records have begun to write themselves.
iter_9: The final volume is being written now. By you.

first_meet: Howdy! Don't see many strangers in the field. Welcome.
I tend the crops here. Honest work. Good for the soul.
neutral: Weather's been fine for the harvest.
These crops grow even when the simulation glitches. Stubborn things.
I lost a row of beans to a Crash Daemon last week. They eat everything.
Good food makes good adventurers.
Take some carrots. They're free.
My grandkids used to run through here...
iter_6: The seasons feel the same every iteration. That's how I count time.
iter_9: I planted seeds this morning. Don't know who'll harvest them.

first_meet: Hi! Hi! What's your name? I'm Bit!
Are you an adventurer? Can I see your sword?
neutral: Watch this! Watch this!
Mom says I shouldn't talk to strangers but you look NICE.
I'm gonna be an adventurer when I grow up!
Did you fight the Compiler? Did you?!
I drew you a picture! It's of you and the Sage. Look!
Tag! You're it!
iter_5: I've seen you before. Have I? It's weird.
iter_9: Mom says this is the last time. I don't get it.

first_meet: Sit with me, child. Let an old voice tell you a story.
My name is Legacy. The town gave it to me. I forgot the other one.
neutral: I remember when the simulation was younger.
Each iteration teaches us something. Some lessons we must learn many times.
The Sage and I have known each other a long time.
Would you like to hear about the founders? It's a long story.
Time moves differently for me now.
Sit. Listen. The story is the only thing that matters.
iter_7: You and I have spoken many times. You don't remember. I do.
iter_9: The story ends soon. I hope you write a good one.

first_meet: Friend! I have JUST the thing for you. Come closer!
Trade's the name, deals are my game. What do you need?
neutral: I have just the thing for you, friend!
Rare imports today. Limited time, of course.
Where do I get my goods? Outside. Don't ask further.
This dagger? Hand-forged by a master. Or a robot. The price is the same.
Special discount for loyal customers. You qualify.
Did I mention I have just the thing for you?
iter_4: I find new things in the deeper iterations. Come back tomorrow.
iter_9: Last sale, friend. Everything must go. Take what you need.

first_meet: AH! You're awake! I mean — hello, fellow being!
I study the simulation. You ARE the simulation. We have much to discuss!
neutral: AH I'VE GOT IT! ...wait, no, lost it.
The data shards from the dungeon are FASCINATING.
You're a unique iteration of the Globbler protocol. Did you know?
I'm working on a theory about the reset. Don't tell the Sage.
This device measures your... you... your YOU-ness.
Can I have a sample of your... never mind, the device is broken again.
iter_9: My final experiment. I'm so close to understanding.

first_meet: Hello, traveler. Stand still a moment. Yes... yes, I see something.
I am Render. I paint what I see. And I see more than most.
neutral: I see something in you that I haven't seen in others.
Stand still, I'm trying to capture the light on your face.
Each portrait I paint of you looks slightly different. Strange, isn't it?
The town has so many colors. The dungeon has only two.
I painted the Compiler once. I burned the painting.
Art outlasts iterations. I think.
iter_5: I painted a memory of you yesterday. I don't know how I knew.
iter_9: This is the last portrait I'll paint of you. Make it count.

first_meet: ♪ Heeeey there, friend ♪... oh, sorry, I was in the middle of a verse.
Sync, music in my soul, lute in my hand. Stay and listen?
neutral: ♪ The town is quiet today ♪
Want me to play you something? Free of charge.
I made up a song about you yesterday. Wanna hear?
Bit dances when I play. It's the cutest thing.
Music doesn't reset between iterations. I think that's important.
♪ Globbler in the dungeon, brave and tall ♪
iter_8: I've been playing this melody for 8 iterations. It's getting longer.
iter_9: The final verse. I've been waiting to play it for you.

first_meet: Halt. Identification. ... ah. The Globbler. Pass, citizen.
I am Sentinel. I watch the gates. You will see me here, always.
neutral: All clear, citizen.
No threats reported.
I will inform you if anything approaches.
Stand at attention.
Duty above all.
The gates remain closed to outsiders. Locals may pass.
iter_2: Citizen. There has been activity at the southern gate. Be cautious.
iter_9: The final watch. I will hold this post until the end. Citizen.
